title: Newfury
summary: Newfury is a spell used by members of the Blood Spiral Brotherhood to restore energy and to give the user more agility, allowing for quick movements.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Shauna used this spell to fight Sophie Casterwill upon ambushing the Huntik team with Wind on their way to a Huntik Foundation safe house. Shauna was quickly able to knock Sophie to the ground with the spell's help. [The Secret of Two Generations]

In search of Void, at Klaus' bookshop, Shauna used the spell against Stack. He was unable to hit Shauna back and was knocked away a big distance by her quick bursts of attacks. [The Blood Spiral]

Lok Lambert and Sophie were tasked to give Vigilante's amulet to the Huntik Foundation Dutch HQ. On their way there, they were ambushed by a pair of Silent Soldiers; the male one used this spell and started fighting Lok. After a struggle, the same Silent Soldier grabbed the knocked female Soldier and fled the encounter. [Den vs Harrison]

Some Silent Soldiers used the spell to make themselves more agile when going down a mountain to chase the Huntik Team during the mission Call of the Casterwill. When fighting Dante Vale during the same mission, at the Pyramid of the Sun, a Silent Soldier used Newfury. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

Harrison Fears used this spell while fighting Lok at the top of the Castle of Vlad Dracul, while trying to prevent the Huntik Team from stopping Tantras' ritual with the Heart of Vlad Dracul. Harrison was able to knock Lok off the elevated place they were fighting in down through some rooftops. [Lok's Leadership]

New Fury was used again by Shauna to break out of the bonds of a Spidertouch spell cast by both Dante and Den Fears during the Rise from the Ashes mission at the Phoenix Volcano. [The Phoenix's Ashes]

Shauna used the spell once again on the longest night of the year at the surroundings of the Spiral Mark against Mallory and White. Shauna was quickly able to knock out the two Seekers using the spell's granted extra agility. [Lok and the Betrayer]

At one point, Newfury was used by Shuana against Lok and Freelancer. [OAL-089]
